name: scout
description: Research any company: what it does, recent news, real tech stack from GitHub, culture and red flags.

brave_api_key.title: Brave Search API key
brave_api_key.description: Strongly recommended. Free tier at brave.com/search/api. Without a key, search falls back to DuckDuckGo, which sometimes blocks automated searches.

firecrawl_api_key.title: Firecrawl API key
firecrawl_api_key.description: Optional. Used for search when there is no Brave key, and for reading JavaScript-heavy pages.

github_token.title: GitHub token
github_token.description: Optional. Enables company research on GitHub. Use a fine-grained token with public repository read access only.

notes_directory.title: Notes folder
notes_directory.description: Where your research notebook (notes.db) is stored. Leave blank for ~/.scout, the same notebook the Claude Desktop extension uses.
